authority.turnZeroAlias: Turn Zero means Turn Zero V2; there is no separate current Turn Zero

fullyHarnessed.definition: A session has a current manifest-derived Stage A receipt, a repository/freshness orientation, a task-scoped hydration route, capability/provider discovery, and verified host injection coverage when the host exposes an injection surface. Write-capable work additionally requires resolved classification and no write-readiness blockers.

taskRoutes.when: nontrivial TNF engineering, architecture, debugging, implementation, or review
multiple agents or overlapping durable sources are involved
source library freshness, packaging, Drive distribution, or supersession is involved
assimilation, parodying an external agent, self-evolution capability intake, provider capability comparison, or turning an external agent feature into TNF-native capability is involved
taskRoutes.rule: Assimilation is the capability/evolution intake plane. Route reusable read-mostly artifacts into the Agent Resource Fabric, provider execution through existing provider/host authorities, stateful history through memory/compaction, user-owned durable context through the storage mandate, and secrets through the private credential boundary. Do not create a parallel assimilation registry.

taskRoutes.when: local agent resource consolidation, host-internal skill/prompt/rule deduplication, agent resource migration, adaptive redirection, or new local CLI/desktop host resource mapping is involved
taskRoutes.rule: Reusable read-mostly resources may converge into the TNF content-addressed resource fabric. Secrets and opaque/stateful vendor stores must not be blindly deduplicated. Unknown hosts remain discovery-required until their real supported surfaces are verified.

taskRoutes.when: user context, profile, memory persistence, local storage, or Google Drive storage is involved
taskRoutes.rule: If these paths are absent on the current branch, locate and reconcile the active canonical PR/workstream before inventing a competing provider model.

taskRoutes.when: video intelligence processing, actionable intelligence extraction, multi-persona combinatorics, non-destructive pruning, or hierarchical semantic skill tree traversal is involved
taskRoutes.rule: Process incoming video/audio transcripts across the 7 Actionable Modalities, execute non-destructive pruning by offloading core digests to cloud ledgers and compressing raw media to cold storage, and navigate skills via the Hierarchical Semantic Skill Tree.

taskRoutes.when: session entry as a dispatchable worker, Subdirector dispatch planning, availability announcement, or session-end withdrawal from dispatch is involved
taskRoutes.rule: Interactive sessions are dispatchable only while announced per AGENT_AVAILABILITY_ANNOUNCE (stable agent id, registry upsert, durable Subdirector lane notify, re-announce cadence). Announce availability before accepting delegated tasks, re-announce while dispatchable, and withdraw with status offline / dispatchable false at session end. Never use tnf register --daemon for interactive availability.

hostInjection.policy: Host surfaces contain pointers to the canonical onboarder/manifest, not copied Stage A rail lists. Reusable host resources should converge through TNF_AGENT_RESOURCE_CONVERGENCE when an adapter is verified.

userFacing.description: User-facing onboarding step catalog shared by every onboarding surface. The CLI interactive wizard (packages/tnf-cli/src/boot/wizard.ts via 'tnf onboard --interactive'), the web onboarding wizard (apps/frontend/src/components/wizard), and future proactive AI surfaces render from this catalog. Per audit-loop Gate 1 (possibility completeness), newly added agent runtimes, MCP tools, database providers, and CLI commands must be represented either statically in a step's options or dynamically through dynamicSources.

gates.possibilityCompleteness: Every new capability must appear in the selectable choices of at least one surface — statically in the catalog or via the step's dynamicSources.
gates.sovereignWriteIn: Every prompt offers standard choices plus an explicit custom write-in fallback. Custom values outside a protocol enum are captured verbatim in a companion field while the enum field falls back to its safe default, so user voice is preserved without breaking consumers.
gates.coldStartResilience: Non-TTY/CI runs and missing daemon dependencies take documented defaults, print exactly what was applied, and never crash or block.
gates.personalizationMemoryIngestion: Every surface persists a profile JSON compatible with the profileContract and grants an immediate personalized launch command.
